_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/dam.json — RoomSpec for De Dam (the city, district 4: the Dam): the Dam: the Royal Palace along its west side, the Nieuwe Kerk at its north-west corner, the National Monument on the east, the department store on the north by the way into Damrak. The November funfair was up when it happened, and the army made the square the evacuation point around it: the Ferris wheel and the rides still lit and stopped, buses lined up with their doors open, army trucks, a field hospital, and the luggage of thousands left where the queues were. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

interactables.text: The Royal Palace. Every window lit, every door shut. Over the balcony someone has hung a bedsheet: EVACUATIEPUNT DAM.
The Ferris wheel, stopped, its lights still running round. High up, one gondola's door swings open in the wind.
The carousel's organ is still playing. The horses have stopped halfway up their poles.
The buses never left. Their doors are open, their engines off, the seats full of bags.
The National Monument. On its steps, hundreds of candles, burned down. Names written in chalk round the base.
Damrak, straight to Centraal. The barriers are chained together here; the army closed it. There has to be another way round.
